label_standard_v0: production configuration (PREC=Normal, ALGO=Fast, NPAR=16 hybrid, FERMICONVERGE=0.01)

electronic_state.note: mu_e_actual is the converged value (CPM-ion line); TARGETMU is the request. Label states by mu_e_actual/N_e_final.

labels.energy_label_status: UNCONFIRMED: which term maps to the trainer's energy target (and its consistency with the forces, which are derivatives of the free energy TOTEN at fixed N_e) is not decided here; select explicitly at training time.
labels.forces_note: raw forces on all atoms from the single TOTAL-FORCE block (static run); forces on fixed atoms are NOT zeroed; identical to vasprun.xml
labels.stress_note: printed by VASP for the periodic cell including vacuum/solvent; not a physical slab stress

CHGCAR.note: electron density rho_e(r)*V on the fine FFT grid (first block only; PAW augmentation block follows). sum/N_grid = N_e electrons. Positive = electrons.

LOCPOT.note: LVHAR=.TRUE.: Hartree (electrostatic) potential only, eV, fine grid.

PHI.note: phi = phi_explicit + phi_solv (solvation.F:1846): total electrostatic potential of the electrolyte model that drives the ion response; u = PHI/(k_B*298 K) with k_B = 8.6173857e-5 eV/K in the code. No volume factor. Sign: more negative -> anion enrichment.

VSOLV.note: V_corr (solvation.F:1832): correction potential actually added to the KS Hamiltonian.

RHOB.note: dielectric bound charge n_b(r) multiplied by the cell volume Omega (solvation.F:1375/1851): divide by V for e/A^3.

RHOION.note: net mobile-ion charge density multiplied by Omega (solvation.F:1384/1852): RHOION/V = n_anion - n_cation in ions/A^3 (validated against the PHI/SION reconstruction, relL2 ~1e-11).

ELOC.note: local electric field, z component only (solvation.F:1849).

SION.note: ion accessibility mask in [0,1] (Stern layer excluded), solvation.F:2067.

POT.note: present in the run directories; semantics NOT verified in the source audit (parameter_map.md section C does not cover it).
